children: GoPro entered into an Agreement and Plan of Merger with Action Acquisitions and its subsidiary Starman Optical. At closing, each GoPro share will convert into the right to receive $1.14 in cash plus 0.1 share of the surviving company, subject to customary adjustments. Equity awards will be assumed on current terms, and warrants will be cashed out at Black-Scholes value. The deal requires stockholder approval, regulatory clearance, and other customary conditions, with funding supported by an equity commitment from Midtown Equities.
: Pursue strategic combination and deliver cash and stock to shareholders
